description: The smallest set this app needs: open a folder chooser, open a URL in the browser, and check for and install its own updates. Anything wider would be a capability the window could use without the code asking for it.

permissions.description: The three URLs this app has a button for, and nothing else. The bare permission enables the command but allows no URL through: every link in the About panel and the update strip failed silently, because the window discarded the rejection. A scope is not optional here — it is the whole permission. The site is a pattern because the changelog page carries a locale; the repository is spelled out in full, because the app links to one repository and an org-wide wildcard would grant every other one for nothing.
